versions.title: Initial release
items: Organizations, members, and role-based permissions
Customers and customer portal for ticket collaboration
Projects, tasks, subtasks, tags, and Kanban boards
Tickets with SLA rules and attachments
Resource planning Gantt with allocations and calendars
Time tracking, active timers, and call records
Dashboard KPIs, portfolio, work summary, and reporting hub
Applications and releases with PDF export
Integrations for Jira, GitHub, Gitea, Outlook, and email queue
Optional Redis cache, API tokens, and IDE Kanban extensions

versions.title: Session, reporting, and navigation
items: Stronger session and token handling for signed-in users
Theme palette selection across the UI
Pinned navigation and clearer project filters
Commit history graph and branch metadata on projects
Reporting hub CSV export improvements
Unplanned-task filtering and planning drag auto-scroll

versions.title: Myelin branding and multi-language UI
items: Product rebranded to Myelin across the live app
UI translations for English, Portuguese, Spanish, and French
CI tagging support for versioned Docker releases

versions.title: Organization analytics
items: Organization detail analytics with multi-series charts
Richer reporting metrics by status, user, and task type

versions.title: Runtime locales and proxy support
items: Locale catalogs available at runtime in Docker images
Trust-proxy settings for correct client IPs behind reverse proxies
Portuguese translation consistency updates

versions.title: Container health checks
items: Dedicated liveness endpoint for container health checks
Docker health probe aligned with runtime PORT

versions.title: Manual and ops polish
items: In-app Myelin user manual and getting-started notes
Dynamic Docker health check port and clearer deploy docs
Portuguese wording refinements for organization switcher and out of office
